description: Create LLMImprovementProposer (src/nexus/evolution/llm_proposer.py) and IsolatedSandbox (src/nexus/evolution/isolated_sandbox.py) - LLM-based proposal generation with heuristic fallback, and resource-isolated sandbox.
steps: Create src/nexus/evolution/llm_proposer.py with class LLMImprovementProposer(llm_callable: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]], fallback_proposer: ImprovementProposer | None = None) containing: generate_proposal(company_id: UUID, context: dict) -> dict that sends structured prompt to LLM and parses JSON response into proposal with implementation_steps field. On any LLM failure (exception, invalid JSON, missing fields), falls back to fallback_proposer.propose_skill_improvement or returns a heuristic proposal. Follow the exact same pattern as LLMTaskPlanner in src/nexus/orchestration/llm_planner.py.

Create src/nexus/evolution/isolated_sandbox.py with class IsolatedSandbox containing: __init__(max_cost_cents: int = 1000, max_duration_seconds: int = 300, max_memory_mb: int = 512); create_session(proposal_id: UUID, config: dict) -> UUID that creates a copy-on-write state container; execute(session_id: UUID, callable_fn: Callable, *args) -> dict that runs callable within resource tracking (cost, duration, memory accumulation) and aborts with ResourceLimitExceeded if any limit breached; get_resource_usage(session_id: UUID) -> dict showing current usage vs limits; abort(session_id: UUID) -> None to forcefully terminate a session; cleanup(session_id: UUID) -> None to remove session state. Also define ResourceLimitExceeded(Exception) in the same file.
Add both new classes to src/nexus/evolution/__init__.py exports

Create tests/test_llm_proposer.py with TestLLMImprovementProposer class: test successful LLM proposal generation with AsyncMock returning valid JSON; test fallback on invalid JSON; test fallback on LLM exception; test that implementation_steps is always present in output; test with explicit fallback_proposer instance.

Create tests/test_isolated_sandbox.py with TestIsolatedSandbox class: test create_session returns UUID; test execute within limits returns result; test execute breaching cost limit raises ResourceLimitExceeded; test execute breaching duration limit raises ResourceLimitExceeded; test get_resource_usage returns accurate tracking; test abort marks session inactive; test cleanup removes session.
acceptance_criteria: LLMImprovementProposer follows exact same LLM callable pattern as LLMTaskPlanner
LLMImprovementProposer always includes 'implementation_steps' list in output
LLMImprovementProposer gracefully falls back on any LLM failure
IsolatedSandbox tracks cost, duration, and memory as logical accumulators (not actual OS-level limits)
IsolatedSandbox raises ResourceLimitExceeded when any limit is breached during execute()
verification: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.pyenv/shims:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_llm_proposer.py tests/test_isolated_sandbox.py tests/test_evolution.py --tb=short -q
